kpi_matrix.business_definition: Observed target-audit coverage by collection context and sampling era; not network coverage.
kpi_matrix.reporting_grain: collection_context + sampling_era + monitored target + UTC observation window
kpi_matrix.calculation_logic: Distinct monitored target identities and completed target audits, segmented by era/context; never rank on raw observation count alone.
kpi_matrix.denominator: Approved monitoring panel denominator is available; network denominator requires GTFS/warehouse coverage.
kpi_matrix.missing_evidence: GTFS/warehouse network universe and complete source observation coverage.
kpi_matrix.confidence_limitation: Legacy7 is a limited monitoring panel and cannot support network-wide claims.

kpi_matrix.business_definition: Share of eligible source timing occurrences with a validated scheduled/timetabled arrival.
kpi_matrix.reporting_grain: unique source event identity + service date + stop call + arrival context
kpi_matrix.calculation_logic: COUNT of non-NULL timetabled arrivals divided by eligible timing occurrences after explicit identity and service-date rules.
kpi_matrix.denominator: Eligible timing occurrences with a valid event/stop/service-date basis; not available in this readback.
kpi_matrix.missing_evidence: Live SELECT access to source timing and schedule objects.
kpi_matrix.confidence_limitation: No live measurement; unavailable is not zero.

kpi_matrix.business_definition: Share of eligible timing occurrences with a provider EstimatedTime.
kpi_matrix.reporting_grain: unique source event identity + service date + stop call + timing context
kpi_matrix.calculation_logic: COUNT of non-NULL EstimatedTime divided by eligible timing occurrences; label as estimate availability only.
kpi_matrix.denominator: Eligible timing occurrences after identity and context filters; not available in this readback.
kpi_matrix.missing_evidence: Live SELECT access to MddMac timing/call observations.
kpi_matrix.confidence_limitation: Estimated arrival is not confirmed actual arrival and must not be relabeled as actual delay.

kpi_matrix.business_definition: Distribution of explicitly labelled estimated arrival difference from timetable by monitored station.
kpi_matrix.reporting_grain: station/stop position + unique source event + service date + arrival context
kpi_matrix.calculation_logic: EstimatedTime minus TimetabledTime only when both comparable values exist; summarize median/quantiles/count with denominator.
kpi_matrix.denominator: Comparable non-NULL estimate/timetable pairs; not available in this readback.
kpi_matrix.missing_evidence: Timing rows, validated stop identity, schedule match, temporal coverage, and sample-quality fields.
kpi_matrix.confidence_limitation: Limited Legacy7 panel; no causal or actual-physical-delay interpretation.

kpi_matrix.business_definition: Explicitly labelled estimated-arrival performance by validated line/service identity.
kpi_matrix.reporting_grain: line/service + service date + time window + unique source event
kpi_matrix.calculation_logic: Aggregate comparable estimate/timetable pairs only after validated line/service and schedule matching.
kpi_matrix.denominator: Comparable matched event-stop pairs by line/service; not available in this readback.
kpi_matrix.missing_evidence: Live timing, static identity, schedule, and network sampling coverage.
kpi_matrix.confidence_limitation: Tiered50 or another representative coverage decision is required before network reliability claims.

kpi_matrix.business_definition: Estimated-delay distribution by explicit UTC/local reporting time bucket, with coverage denominator.
kpi_matrix.reporting_grain: time bucket + monitored station/line + unique source event
kpi_matrix.calculation_logic: Derive time bucket from an explicitly selected observation/event timestamp; preserve UTC window and sampling era.
kpi_matrix.denominator: Comparable timing pairs observed in each time bucket; not available in this readback.
kpi_matrix.missing_evidence: Timing observations, observation timestamps, and coverage denominator.
kpi_matrix.confidence_limitation: Cadence and panel selection can confound apparent time-of-day patterns.

kpi_matrix.business_definition: Location repeatedly appearing in the upper tail of estimated delay across independent events and comparable windows.
kpi_matrix.reporting_grain: location + service date/window + independent source event
kpi_matrix.calculation_logic: Use event-level tail membership and repeated-window coverage; never rank by raw observation count.
kpi_matrix.denominator: Independent eligible source events and observed windows per location; not available in this readback.
kpi_matrix.missing_evidence: Timing, identity, window completeness, and source coverage quality.
kpi_matrix.confidence_limitation: Candidate investigation signal only; not proof of a location causing delay.

kpi_matrix.business_definition: Observed change in estimated delay between consecutive stops for the same defensibly matched journey.
kpi_matrix.reporting_grain: service date + journey identity + consecutive stop pair + observation interval
kpi_matrix.calculation_logic: Join only validated same-journey, direction/line-consistent, stop-sequence-ordered records; compare estimates, not actual delay.
kpi_matrix.denominator: Matched consecutive-stop pairs with comparable timing evidence; not available in this readback.
kpi_matrix.missing_evidence: Journey identity, stop sequence, temporal consistency, and timing rows.
kpi_matrix.confidence_limitation: Observed estimate change is not causal propagation or proof of dwell delay.

kpi_matrix.business_definition: Candidate association between estimated delay change and dwell/stop-service indicators where source fields support it.
kpi_matrix.reporting_grain: journey + stop call + consecutive stop pair + service date
kpi_matrix.calculation_logic: Compare timing changes with explicitly persisted stop flags/bay/context; report as hypothesis only.
kpi_matrix.denominator: Matched pairs with both timing and relevant stop-service evidence; not available in this readback.
kpi_matrix.missing_evidence: Call flags, stop sequence, timing, and validated journey continuity.
kpi_matrix.confidence_limitation: No causal attribution from dwell-related association.

kpi_matrix.business_definition: Candidate association where an estimated-delay increase persists to a later stop on the same matched journey.
kpi_matrix.reporting_grain: service date + journey identity + ordered stop sequence + source observation interval
kpi_matrix.calculation_logic: Separate observed estimate change, candidate propagation, provider-reported disruption association, and proven causation.
kpi_matrix.denominator: Matched journeys with at least two ordered, comparable stop calls; not available in this readback.
kpi_matrix.missing_evidence: Live source call/timing rows and reliable journey continuity.
kpi_matrix.confidence_limitation: Current readback cannot establish continuity; conclusion is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.

kpi_matrix.business_definition: Persisted provider Situation/Attribute evidence, its identity/version continuity, and affected-line/journey linkage.
kpi_matrix.reporting_grain: situation identity/version + observation + affected entity + association scope
kpi_matrix.calculation_logic: Count source evidence and explicit codes separately from estimated-delay observations; do not infer cause from free text alone.
kpi_matrix.denominator: Persisted source Situation evidence occurrences and linked/unlinked eligible observations; not available in this readback.
kpi_matrix.missing_evidence: Situation, Attribute, service-section, and historical Windows evidence rows.
kpi_matrix.confidence_limitation: Situation association is not proof that a specific situation caused a specific delay.

kpi_matrix.business_definition: Coverage, identity quality, parser-gap, missing-field, and sample-era evidence attached to every manager-facing metric.
kpi_matrix.reporting_grain: metric population + source event/observation + sampling era + quality classification
kpi_matrix.calculation_logic: Expose denominators, missingness, ambiguity, sampling era, and matching quality next to every result.
kpi_matrix.denominator: Current target-audit denominators are partially available; source-event quality denominators are not.
kpi_matrix.missing_evidence: Source timing/call/parser-gap rows and static/network coverage.
kpi_matrix.confidence_limitation: Only monitoring-panel audit lineage is directly observed in this readback.

highest_priority_data_gaps: Grant a dedicated read-only analytics/review principal access to the required source, historical, GTFS, warehouse, and analytics objects, or run the diagnostic under an approved read-only analyst credential.
Re-run physical metadata discovery and bounded evidence queries with the approved analyst scope; do not rely on repository DDL as a live schema substitute.
Measure timing availability, source-event identity ambiguity, call/timing context, parser gaps, Situation/Attribute coverage, and freshness from live rows.
Validate journey continuity and scheduled stop order before considering any downstream propagation candidate.
Agree the reporting population and sampling-era denominator before any manager-facing KPI implementation; keep Legacy7 separate from Tiered50 and imported research.
required_decisions_before_implementation: Which approved read-only principal may inspect the authoritative SQL evidence without changing production runtime permissions?
Which explicit UTC analysis windows and service-date rules govern each KPI?
What minimum identity/matching quality is required before a consecutive-stop association is shown as a candidate?
Which KPIs, if any, may be exposed for the limited Legacy7 panel before representative Tiered50 coverage exists?
Which source-reported Situation fields are reportable as evidence, and which are explicitly not treated as causal attribution?
